summary: Iteration 23 — Verified all 10 features from the review request across backend + frontend. ALL PASSED. Backend: FID/primary_fid/path_measurements persist correctly across POST/GET/PUT/list (6/6 pytest). Frontend: FID input + Primary FID toggle (default OFF) + Path Measurements rows all render on Handhole/FBT etc, live summary 'Up 25ft, In 15ft — 40 ft total' correct, warning toast when toggling Primary FID ON while another item already has it, Map top summary includes '+ 40.0 ft path' and grand total incremented by 40, ASE Nearest fiber FID auto-populates from primary_fid item + success toast, multi-primary warning toast shown, path_of_approach appends 'TEST-HH-A: Up 25ft, In 15ft', EF Requirements ↔ 'What Site Requirements are already provided?' semicolon-joined sync (add/remove/preserve custom text) works, Move Items mode activates with 'Move Mode Active' overlay and 11 draggable markers (poles+underground+measurement pills+labels). Visual regression: 5 orange measurement pills all connect properly, no stray dangling connectors. Backend regression: EOP (non-FID type) saves cleanly with no FID field.

issues: 'DATE OF SITE VISIT' still uses the browser-default <input type='date'> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker used elsewhere. Minor UX inconsistency.

design_issues.screen: ASE Form — auto-populate toasts on load
issues: 'Nearest fiber FID set from Handhole TEST-HH-A (Primary FID)' toast fires twice on initial load (React 18 StrictMode double-invocation / useEffect re-run). Not a functional bug but produces duplicate user-visible toasts. Consider guarding with a ref-based one-shot in ASEChecklistTab.jsx (mirror the existing fidWarnedRef pattern for the success toast too).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Debounce/one-shot the 'Nearest fiber FID set from …' success toast in ASEChecklistTab.jsx to avoid the duplicate toast on initial mount (add a ref like fidSetRef alongside fidWarnedRef).
OPTIONAL: Replace the native <input type='date'> for 'DATE OF SITE VISIT' in ASEForm with the app's shadcn calendar/date picker for UI consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: ASEChecklistTab.jsx L42-56: useEffect depends on [underground] with eslint-disable — success toast fires on every underground change, not once. The fidWarnedRef only gates the multi-primary warning, not the success toast. Cheap improvement: add a matching ref (e.g. fidSetRef) to fire the success toast at most once per session, or track last-set FID.
UndergroundForm.jsx: FID_TYPES const is duplicated (imported list) — fine for now, but if the underground type list grows, extract to a shared constants file to keep FID_TYPES in sync.
JobMap.jsx L1058 pathFeet reducer + L1277 summary render is correct and uses fmtFeet consistently; grand total math (grandTotalFeet + ugFeet + pathFeet) is right.

underground.py model: path_measurements is List[dict] rather than a typed submodel — losing schema validation on {direction, feet}. Consider PathMeasurement(BaseModel){direction:str, feet:float} for stricter validation (nice-to-have).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 2 underground items on job A050ABC (TEST-HH-A Handhole with primary_fid=true, TESTFID-001, path_measurements=[Up 25, In 15]; TEST-FBT-B FBT with primary_fid=true, TESTFID-002). Both DELETED at end of run. Verified via GET /api/jobs/{id}/underground — back to original 2 seed items (HH-1, HB-1). ASE data on seed job unchanged (Save button not clicked during EF Requirements test).

Data-testids in place: ug-fid-input, ug-primary-fid-toggle, add-path-measurement-btn, path-direction-select-{i}, path-feet-input-{i}, path-measurements-summary, remove-path-measurement-{i}, map-measurements-summary, edit-map-dropdown-btn, edit-all-btn. Move Mode gives 11 leaflet-marker-draggable elements (poles + underground + measurement pills + labels).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional bugs found. Two minor UX observations (duplicate success toast on ASE mount, native date input) — non-blocking, documented in design_issues and action_items.
